mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) for two consecutive months signals a weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 2 consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises > 1% MoM and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is above 2% year-over-year, it signals a mismatch between monetary policy and inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% quarter-over-quarter and Industrial Production (INDPRO) is declining, it signals a supply-side contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 QoQ < 1% and INDPRO declines and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, the hypothesis is rejected.
